evidence.recognition: Five first-person lines the reader will recognize: "Avoiding this problem is my way of staying in control."
evidence.mechanism: Deactivation is explained as signal suppression, not absence of need: "turning down the signal that asks somebody to come closer."
evidence.honesty: Limits ride alongside every citation: "every step from there to an adult... is an inference rather than a measurement."
evidence.ownership: The practice is self-run ("Run a pullback log for two weeks"), though therapy is endorsed in FAQs and a seminar is pitched.
evidence.clarity: The answer box is one long but plain sentence; the identify box is instantly scannable.
evidence.gap_vs_serp: The ranking titles promise 'Treatment' (WebMD: 'Definition, Signs, Causes & Treatment'); the page explicitly declines any clinical treatment frame and offers only self-directed practice.
